messages:
maya: Heads-up — v2 rollout started at 15:00 UTC. Deploy-bot shows a small spike in 4xx from older SDK clients. Noticing a bunch of requests missing X-Client-Version header. Anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: [deploy] v2 -> 100% traffic eu-west-1 at 15:02 UTC. Metrics: +2.3% 4xx, top error = 400 malformed-request.

sasha: seeing same in gateway logs. Affected tenant subset = mobile app versions < 2.1. They don't send the X-Client-Version header; our v2 routing uses that header for variant selection.

dan: can we tenant-pin the affected customers to v1 while we patch? Would prefer a targeted pin over a full rollback.

pranav: +1 to targeted pin. Alternatively we can add a temporary header shim at the edge to inject X-Client-Version: 0.0.0 for requests that don't include it. That keeps routing logic happy without routing everyone to v1.

maya: sounds reasonable. Do we have a sticky routing rule to keep "no-header" clients on a safe path? We want to avoid flipping traffic back-and-forth for newly upgraded clients.

ops-bot: runbook triggered -> Step 1: deploy shim to canary edge, Step 2: monitor 10m for 4xx regressions, Step 3: optionally add tenant-level pin, Step 4: widen shim. Estimated safe window: ~30m.

sasha: I'll prepare the header-injector config. Config snippet for canary:
```json
{"match": "!has_header('X-Client-Version')", "set_header": {"X-Client-Version": "0.0.0"}}
```
I'll push to staging then canary.

dan: after shim is up, we should update release notes and ping integrations. This is a breaking behavior for older SDKs and we need to be explicit.

maya: who can update the release notes and notify integrators? Also add a short note in the rollback playbook about tenant pins.

liz: I can do release notes + integrator outreach. Draft changelog line: "v2: routing requires X-Client-Version header. Gateway will normalize missing header to 0.0.0 temporarily; mobile SDK patch incoming." I'll post the patch to docs and DM major integrators.

pranav: timeline proposal: shim -> prod canary by 15:20 UTC, monitor 10m, then widen if 4xx drops. If errors persist, apply tenant pin list for the highest-severity tenants.

deploy-bot: action queued: traffic shift + canary -> operator @sasha @pranav. Canary window scheduled 15:25-15:35 UTC.

sasha: pushing shim to canary now. Logs look clean. No increase in 5xx. 400s trending down for affected tenant subset.

maya: good. After stable window we'll remove emergency tenant pins and keep shim until SDK patch ships.

dan: SDK team — please prioritize the mobile patch to send X-Client-Version for older versions. Filed mobile-sdk#334 for tracking.

liz: release notes + integrator ping sent. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/420. Also posted short blurb in #integrations.

sasha: prod canary complete. 400 rate back to baseline. Applied shim globally at 15:32 UTC to avoid further customer impact.

maya: action items captured: sasha keep shim live and add autoscale/hotpath test; dan follow up on SDK patch; liz monitor comms and close loop with top integrators. I'll close this thread when tenant pins are removed.

liz: removing temporary tenant pins from deploybot pinlist now. :white_check_mark:

pranav: monitoring alert cleared. Scheduling a short retro tomorrow 10:00 PT to update deploy playbooks and add a preflight for header requirements.

ops-bot: reminder — update runbook: "gateway normalizes missing X-Client-Version to 0.0.0" and add an e2e preflight test that sends no header.

maya: thanks everyone. Follow-ups: mobile-sdk#334, docs PR 420, runbook update, retro. Closing in a bit once pinned list is empty. :eyes:
